driver_of_the_day.label: +6.6 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Andrea Kimi Antonelli scored 25 from P1 on the grid; the model expected 18.4.

best_drive_from_back.label: P22 to P15
best_drive_from_back.why: Lance Stroll gained 7 places from P22 in the 10th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +7.7 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Lance Stroll's 3-stop race cost 7.7 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 23.4 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 15 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Alexander Albon, lap 46
overtake_of_race.why: Lance Stroll passed Alexander Albon for P15 on lap 46 despite being +0.40 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

smoothest.label: 0.265 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Lewis Hamilton's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.265 s (1 sd).
